train_cartpole_deepq: train a cartpole agent using DeepQ learning with an MLP model and save the trained policy
create_cartpole_env: create a CartPoleBulletEnv environment with rendering disabled for training
build_mlp_model: build a multi-layer perceptron model with 64 hidden units for the DeepQ agent
define_training_callback: define a callback function that stops training when the cartpole reward exceeds 199
save_trained_model: save the trained DeepQ agent model to a pickle file for later use
